D: A teen with no powers becomes a superhero and teams up with Hit-Girl and Big Daddy.
P: Serve the mains when Kick-Ass meets Hit-Girl.
S: Popcorn popped in coconut oil, tossed while hot with melted butter, finely grated parmesan and cracked black pepper, in paper bags.
Bodega bacon, egg and cheese rolls
Dave's walk to school through New York

Soft rolls stuffed with folded fried egg, crisp bacon and melted American cheese, salt, pepper and hot sauce, wrapped in foil like the corner store does it. Fry 8 bacon rashers until crisp. Whisk 6 eggs with salt and pepper and cook as a thin omelette in 20g butter, folding it into 4 squares. Lay 2 slices American cheese on each square to melt. Split and toast 4 soft rolls, add the egg and cheese, then the bacon and a good shake of hot sauce. Wrap each in foil for 2 minutes so everything melts together.

Sweet rockmelon cubes wrapped in prosciutto with basil, a drizzle of aged balsamic and cracked pepper, on picks like a penthouse party. Peel and seed half a rockmelon and cut into 20 cubes. Tear 10 slices of prosciutto in half lengthways. Wrap each melon cube in a strip of prosciutto with a small basil leaf tucked inside and spear with a cocktail pick. Arrange on a platter, drizzle with 1 tbsp aged balsamic and olive oil and finish with cracked black pepper.
M: Atomic Comics New York pepperoni slice

Big thin-crust New York slices with garlicky tomato sauce, mozzarella and crisp pepperoni, folded to eat, with chilli flakes, parmesan and hot honey. Mix 500g bread flour, 325ml water, 2g yeast, 10g salt and 1 tbsp oil and refrigerate 24 hours. Divide into 2 balls and rest at room temperature for 2 hours. Heat the oven with a pizza steel at its highest setting for 45 minutes. Stretch each into a 35cm base, spread with 150ml passata mixed with garlic and oregano, top with 200g grated mozzarella and pepperoni. Bake 7 minutes. Cut into big slices and serve with chilli flakes, parmesan and hot honey.
the treat Big Daddy promises Mindy
Two thin patties smashed on a smoking griddle, American cheese, pickles and burger sauce on toasted buns, double-fried chips alongside.
W: Mindy's reward for doing her training
Vanilla and chocolate ice cream with hot fudge (dark chocolate melted with cream), whipped cream, sprinkles and a cherry in a tall glass.
K: Deep purple grape juice shaken with lime and fresh ginger, topped with soda over frozen grapes, served in small tumblers with a purple straw. Freeze 200g red grapes for 2 hours. Grate 2cm fresh ginger and squeeze the juice through a sieve into a jug. Add 500ml grape juice and the juice of 1 lime and stir. Fill 4 small tumblers with frozen grapes, pour in the grape mix and top each with 60ml soda water.

s.how: Heat 2 tbsp coconut oil with 3 kernels, then add 120g kernels once they pop, cover and shake until the popping slows. Toss with 50g melted butter, 40g finely grated parmesan and plenty of cracked pepper. Fill four paper bags.

Wrap each melon cube in a strip of prosciutto with a small basil leaf tucked inside and spear with a cocktail pick. Arrange on a platter, drizzle with 1 tbsp aged balsamic and olive oil and finish with cracked black pepper.

m.note: the treat Big Daddy promises Mindy
m.how: Mix 100g mayo, 2 tbsp relish and 1 tsp mustard for sauce. Smash 8 thin patties from 800g mince on a smoking griddle, add American cheese and stack two per toasted bun with pickles and sauce. Fry 1kg potato chips twice and salt.

w.note: Mindy's reward for doing her training
w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream. Layer scoops of vanilla and chocolate ice cream in four tall glasses with the hot fudge. Finish with whipped cream, sprinkles and a cherry on top.

d.how: Freeze 200g red grapes for 2 hours. Grate 2cm fresh ginger and squeeze the juice through a sieve into a jug. Add 500ml grape juice and the juice of 1 lime and stir. Fill 4 small tumblers with frozen grapes, pour in the grape mix and top each with 60ml soda water.
